notes.title: 19.10.12 Main Update
notes.notes:
# Main Updates

- Save & Load is now available. You can save when completed a stage. There are 12 available slots. After loaded a slot, the game starts at the beginning of the next stage.

- A minimap now appears on the top right, replacing the old map. Toggled in the ESC menu.

- When your character reaches the bottom of the screen, the item slot become translucent.

- A new power bar displays besides the health bar during the boss battle

- In sake of balance, Marisa's initial health is reset from 100HP to 60HP.

- Replace the sound played when hit.

notes.title: 19.10.07 Main Update
notes.notes:
# Main Updates
- Fixed where the exit confirm menu overlaps the pause menu.
- Further fixed the hitbox glitch occured in stage 5.
- Giant Kedama and Dark Kedama now have two attacks.
- Replace Dark Kedamas in all maps.
- Fixed the hitbox of the doors in the library. Entering the boss room without destroying all the Philosopher's Stones is no longer allowed.
- Lil' Fairy now have a sound effect for her attack.
- Fixed the position of Flan · Patchouli's lasers during her last spell.

## Adjustment
- Most spell casting animation of bosses are now affected by time stop.
- The hitboxs of many enemy's bullets are now decreased by 15%~20%
- Adjusted key config is now only applied during the game. In the title screen though, default config is applied.

notes.title: 19.10.05 Main Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed ESC-pausing, mainly including:
 Pressing ESC in the telpher ejects the player and stuck the game.
 Pressing ESC during a boss fight causes various glitches.
- You may now skip cutscenes by pressing LCtrl.

Gamepad support coming soon, please wait warmly.
